scenario: HR compliance team runs a DEI hiring audit across a pool of job applicants. They use NLP analysis to assess the linguistic quality of cover letters, apply a priority scoring model to rank candidates by engagement signals, and generate a structured audit report summarizing representation and selection patterns for review by the diversity committee.
info_flow: nlp-toolkit analyzes each applicant cover letter to produce vocabulary richness and writing quality metrics → sentiment-priority-scorer ingests those metrics alongside engagement signals to compute a candidate priority score → reporting aggregates scores and generates a DEI audit report for the diversity committee.
